tasks.title: IMPL (harness_self_fix): add pure _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline helper and cap the idle sleep_target by it in run_daemon
acceptance_criteria: Adds a NEW pure top-level helper `_soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir) -> float | None` in harness/autowork_daemon.py, anchored on the existing top-level `_retry_blocked_tasks`.

The helper reuses the exact _retry_blocked_tasks enumeration: same tasks/blocked/*.json sorted glob, skip names ending .retry.json, skip any tid with a blocked/<tid>.exhausted marker, parse the blocked/<tid>.retry.json sidecar for {attempts:int, ts:float, last_outcome:str} defensively, derive effective_max = 1 if last_outcome in the INLINED tuple ('synthesis_or_ast_failed','embedded_tests_failed','narrow_fuzz_failed') else 3 (NOT referencing the bare _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES name, which is local to _retry_blocked_tasks), and the same 300/3600/86400 tier schedule.
Returns min(last_ts + threshold(attempts)) over retry-ELIGIBLE blocked tasks (attempts < effective_max, not exhausted), or None when there is no eligible blocked task.

The helper is read-only and fail-soft: a missing blocked/ dir, a glob OSError, or a malformed sidecar yields None / is skipped and never raises; it mutates no state (no re-stage, no .exhausted/marker/telemetry writes).

In run_daemon, after `sleep_target = heartbeat if is_idle else poll`, when is_idle, computes dl = _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir) and, if dl is not None, sets sleep_target = min(sleep_target, max(5.0, dl - time.time())).

The non-idle poll branch, the early-wake mtime-watch loop, _retry_blocked_tasks re-stage/exhaust/backoff/escalation semantics, the .exhausted-marker logic, and DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_SEC / _heartbeat_interval are all unchanged; no config knob added.

Implemented via a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ payload with TWO kind:'symbol' patches (both top-level: the new helper anchored on _retry_blocked_tasks, and run_daemon); no exec/eval/compile/__import__ (AST-banned).
Requires the operator decision file state/control/decisions/daemon-idle-sleep-cap-impl.json (harness/autowork_daemon.py is in _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE, orchestrator.py:2577).
Green: python -m pytest tests/harness/test_daemon_idle_sleep_cap.py -q passes (the oracle's own authored file).

spec.objective: Additively cap the idle heartbeat sleep by the soonest pending blocked-retry deadline so a freshly-blocked, retry-eligible task auto-retries on its OWN backoff (~300s) instead of waiting up to the full ~1800s heartbeat for the next idle scan. Add a pure read-only helper that reuses the _retry_blocked_tasks enumeration + backoff tiers, and apply the cap only at the idle-sleep site in run_daemon. The non-idle poll path and the retry/exhaust semantics are unchanged.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW pure top-level helper `_soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir) -> float | None` (anchored on the existing top-level `_retry_blocked_tasks`) that reuses the exact enumeration (sorted tasks/blocked/*.json glob, skip *.retry.json, skip blocked/<tid>.exhausted, defensive {attempts,ts,last_outcome} sidecar parse), derives effective_max from an INLINED ('synthesis_or_ast_failed','embedded_tests_failed','narrow_fuzz_failed') tuple (effective_max=1 for those, else 3), uses the same threshold tiers (300.0 for attempts<=1, 3600.0 for attempts==2, else 86400.0), and returns min(last_ts + threshold(attempts)) over retry-ELIGIBLE blocked tasks (attempts < effective_max), or None when none are eligible.

The helper is read-only and fail-soft: a missing blocked/ dir, a glob OSError, or a malformed/non-JSON sidecar yields None / is skipped and never raises; it performs no re-staging, no .exhausted/marker writes, no telemetry, and no other state mutation.

In run_daemon, at the idle-sleep site (immediately after `sleep_target = heartbeat if is_idle else poll`), when is_idle, compute dl = _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir); if dl is not None, set sleep_target = min(sleep_target, max(5.0, dl - time.time())) so the cap applies only when is_idle and only when a deadline exists and is strictly sooner than the heartbeat, with the 5.0s grace floor keeping the capped sleep > 0 (no busy-spin).

Leave the non-idle poll sleep branch, the early-wake allowlist/brief mtime-watch loop, the _retry_blocked_tasks re-stage/exhaust/backoff/escalation semantics, the .exhausted-marker logic, the _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES local, and DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_SEC / _heartbeat_interval all behaviorally unchanged; add no config knob.
spec.interfaces: harness/autowork_daemon.py. New top-level `def _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir):` returning float|None (mirrors _retry_blocked_tasks:911-999 enumeration; INLINES the deterministic-outcome tuple because _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES is local to _retry_blocked_tasks at :954). run_daemon idle-sleep site is at :2932 (`sleep_target = heartbeat if is_idle else poll`); state_dir, heartbeat, and is_idle (:2920-2922) are in scope, time is imported. Delivered via one __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ payload with two kind:'symbol' patches (both top-level -> direct symbol patches, no R-anchor / no nesting): (1) the new helper anchored on _retry_blocked_tasks, (2) run_daemon. harness.autowork_daemon is in the self-reload watch set (:2879) so the logic change is picked up on the next idle cycle via clean-exit + supervisor respawn.
edge_cases: Retry-eligible blocked task with a partially-elapsed backoff window (attempts=1, recent ts) -> deadline ts+300.0 caps the idle sleep strictly below the 1800s heartbeat.
Empty / missing tasks/blocked/ (or all tasks exhausted) -> helper returns None so the cap is a no-op and the full heartbeat is preserved.
Multiple eligible blocked tasks -> the soonest (min) deadline is returned.
Exhausted task (via .exhausted marker or attempts>=effective_max, including deterministic-outcome budget-1) is excluded from the min.
Malformed (non-JSON) sidecar / glob OSError / missing dir -> fail-soft (None or skip), never raises and never mutates state.
Non-idle iteration (is_idle False) -> sleep_target stays poll, the cap is never applied.
non_goals: No integration test: this is a unit-level daemon idle-sleep-cap helper / harness symbol patch; the oracle drives the REAL _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline over a hermetic synthetic state dir and never drives the daemon loop, an agent, or a real worker -- there is no new runtime/integration surface, so the empty integration_tests list is intentional and excused. Do NOT add real integration_tests.

Do NOT change the _retry_blocked_tasks re-stage / exhaust / backoff semantics, the .exhausted-marker logic, the autobrief escalation, the _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES set, or the non-idle poll sleep branch.
Do NOT add or change any config knob (no new config/config.yaml entry; DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_SEC and _heartbeat_interval stay as-is).

Do NOT let the helper mutate state (no re-staging, no marker/telemetry writes); the helper need not model the dest.exists() re-stage skip (_retry_blocked_tasks:989-990) -- any early-wake on a lingering blocked task is bounded by the grace floor to the poll cadence (no busy-spin).
Do NOT edit any other file or symbol, create a new module, author tests beyond the paired oracle, use exec/eval/compile/__import__, or use the broad adversarial suite as the verification command.
spec.implementation_notes:
Two kind:'symbol' patches in one __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ payload. (1) NEW top-level `_soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir)` anchored on the existing top-level `_retry_blocked_tasks`: pathlib.Path(state_dir)/'tasks'/'blocked'; if not blocked.is_dir(): return None; try sorted(blocked.glob('*.json')) except OSError: return None; for each p skip p.name.endswith('.retry.json'); tid = p.name[:-5]; skip if (blocked/f'{tid}.exhausted').exists(); read blocked/f'{tid}.retry.json' defensively (json.loads, isinstance guards mirroring :945-953, except (OSError, ValueError) -> defaults 0,0.0,''); effective_max = 1 if last_outcome in ('synthesis_or_ast_failed','embedded_tests_failed','narrow_fuzz_failed') else 3 (INLINE -- do NOT reference the bare _DETERMINISTIC_OUTCOMES name or it NameErrors); skip if attempts >= effective_max; threshold = 300.0 if attempts <= 1 else (3600.0 if attempts == 2 else 86400.0); dl = last_ts + threshold; soonest = dl if soonest is None else min(soonest, dl); return soonest. Pure/read-only -- never rename, never write markers/telemetry. (2) PATCH run_daemon: after `sleep_target = heartbeat if is_idle else poll` add `if is_idle:
    _dl = _soonest_blocked_retry_deadline(state_dir)
    if _dl is not None:
        sleep_target = min(sleep_target, max(5.0, _dl - time.time()))`. Keep the rest of run_daemon (step calc, while-slept loop, mtime watch) byte-identical in behavior. Requires operator decision file state/control/decisions/daemon-idle-sleep-cap-impl.json (autowork_daemon.py in _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE, orchestrator.py:2577). Verified by the oracle's authored tests/harness/test_daemon_idle_sleep_cap.py (fix-forward redpair); do NOT run the broad adversarial suite.
